narrative_drafts.about_us_draft: A & J Roofing Solutions is a Cairns roofing and cladding business based at 98 Buchan St, Portsmith QLD 4870. The company’s current website positions the team as “Specialists in metal roofing, ceiling & wall cladding,” with a long-standing service claim of “Servicing Cairns & Far North Queensland for over 18 years.” Those two facts should lead the About page because they explain both what the business does and where it belongs. The company works across residential and commercial roofing, supported by dedicated website sections for both audiences. For homeowners, that means a local team to speak with about roofing and cladding needs. For commercial clients, builders and property managers, it means a trade specialist with experience in more demanding project requirements. The existing copy refers to “extensive experience and industry knowledge” and the ability to undertake “demanding and often unique” requirements connected to modern architectural design. In the new site, that should be rewritten in simpler language: A & J handles practical roofing and cladding work for Cairns properties, including projects where detail, coordination and the right material choices matter. The supplied audit corpus also records ABN 34 134 811 831 and trust claims of Licensed and fully insured. These should appear on the About page once the exact licence information is verified. The page should close with a direct contact invitation: call 07 4035 6187 or email admin@anjroofing.com.au to discuss a residential or commercial roofing project in Cairns or Far North Queensland.
